facebook.caption:
POV: you wandered into Chợ đêm Phú Quốc and smelled something better than everything on the tourist menu.

Bánh canh chả cá chợ đêm. 4.9 stars. 81 reviews. Under $10 a person.

Thick rice noodles, fish cake, hot broth at midnight. This is the bowl locals actually eat after dark. No frills. No English menu. Just a plastic stool and the real Phu Quoc.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
